name: @pipeworx/mcp-serper

tools.name: search
tools.description: Google web search via Serper: returns organic results (title, link, snippet, position), an answer box if present, and a knowledge graph summary. Accepts query, result count (max 20), and optional country code (gl) and location for geo-targeted results.

location.description: Location string, e.g. "San Francisco, California, United States"

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: news
tools.description: Google News search via Serper: returns recent news articles (title, link, snippet, source, date) matching the query. Accepts query, result count (max 20), and optional country code (gl).

query.description: Search query, e.g. "federal reserve rate decision"

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

tools.name: places
tools.description: Google Maps local business search via Serper: returns matching places with title, address, rating, review count, category, phone number, and website. Accepts query plus optional country code (gl) and location string for geo-targeting.

query.description: Search query, e.g. "coffee shops near union square"

location.description: Location string, e.g. "San Francisco, California, United States"

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Serper API key for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-serper forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the serper pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
